comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: Which part of everyday life on Mahé surprised you most: housing, work or food prices? If you live in Seychelles, what would you add?

comments.author: @Giles-t4j
comments.text: Being Africa’s richest country sounds impressive, but the grocery prices really put that into perspective.

replies.author: @travellives
replies.text: It’s a real challenge, as the high cost of imported goods makes everyday living expensive even with the nation's economic growth.
